nom: Athletic Cosmetic Company Clear Power Sunscreen SPF 50 Invisible No White Cast Sweat & Water Resistant

avis.texte: The best clear sunscreen! I play tennis in warm and humid weather and this has been so great! Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Good, but I have other sunscreens that work and last betterGood, but I have other sunscreens that work and last better
avis.texte: It's OK, but I think I actually like my other sunscreens better. I guess this is supposed to be superior, due to the "no white cast." I'm finding that white cast actually seems to better protect my sun and it also makes my skin look better. This one looks worse on my skin. The good thing is it does not seem to cause any problems for me, even though I am very sensitive to some products. This is definitely gentle. There is no color and no strong smell. That said, I have other sunscreens that give me good, lasting protection, without irritation but also with a better overall look and feel. This sunscreen is definitely good. It's just not in my top list of favorites.

This is my favorite sunscreen. It's clear, sweat and water resistant and comfortable. I'm an athlete and coach, so I'm in the sun everyday have tried many sunscreens. This is the best sunscreen for sports

avis.titre: A Primer-Like Sunscreen That Holds Up Outdoors!
avis.texte: I had never heard of the Athletic Cosmetic Company before trying this sunscreen, but I was intrigued by the concept of a sport-ready formula designed to hold up during heat, sweat, and outdoor activity. From what I can tell, the brand focuses on high-performance skincare meant to function almost like gear for your skin, which makes sense given the name. While the marketing leans athletic, sunscreen is for everyone, and I was curious how this would perform in everyday life, especially as someone with sensitive combination skin who is picky about facial SPFs. This is a clear gel sunscreen, and the texture immediately stood out to me. It feels almost identical to a silicone makeup primer — that silky, cushiony slip that glides over the skin and leaves a soft matte finish. Since it’s completely clear, there’s zero white cast, which is a huge plus. The formula uses chemical UV filters for broad spectrum SPF 50 protection, and you can feel that flexible, water- and sweat-resistant film it forms, which is likely what helps it stay put outdoors. It sits slightly on the surface of the skin in a smoothing way rather than absorbing like a traditional lotion, which I think is why it gives that blurred, velvety effect. I’ve worn this both barefaced and under makeup, and performance-wise, it’s solid. On no-makeup days, it kept my skin comfortable without making my T-zone look oilier (a common issue for me with sunscreen). Under foundation, it actually behaves nicely because of that primer-

As a tennis coach, I’m in the sun for hours, and this sunscreen really delivers. It’s invisible, sweat-resistant, and never leaves that white residue. Great for training or matches. Nice product for athletes.

This Clear Power Sunscreen has worked well to protect my skin while I am outside on walks or gardening. The formula is silky but not greasy, and is as clear as advertised with no noticeable tinting. The scent is also very mild, much less than standard sunscreen. The bottle is a little stiff and so you have to squeeze pretty hard to dispense product. Be sure to follow the directions to wait 15 minutes for the sunscreen to set/soak into your skin before heading outside and apply every 2 hours. Overall, I definitely recommend!

avis.titre: Glides on silky and smooth, no greasinessGlides on silky and smooth, no greasiness
avis.texte: I live in the deep, hot south and wear sunscreen every day, even in the winter months. Skin issues run in my family and I take sensible precautions to avoid them. That means protecting my skin with sunscreen every time I’m outside. I have used dozens of different sunscreen brands over the years and some I like, and others I don’t. This Athletic Cosmetic Company Clear Power Sunscreen was a winner for me for several reasons. It’s a clear, thick gel that doesn’t drip and run all over the place. It stays put and you can put it exactly where you want it without it dripping. I like that it’s got almost so scent to it because I will mainly be using this on my face and neck. It’s spreads easily and absorbs completely. When I say completely….i mean COMPLETELY! No greasiness at all. It’s so lightweight that I can’t even tell I’m wearing it. I was able to apply my makeup over it and have zero complaints. The first day I wore it, my husband and I were working on our fence for several hours in the hot sun. My skin was fully protected and I did not burn. I noticed that when I was sweating, this sunscreen didn’t sting my eyes, which is a major problem with most of them. This is now my absolute favorite sunscreen. The bottle is small, at only 50ml (1.7 ounces). It’s on the pricier side, but the value is there. I will only be using it on my face and neck because slathering it all over my body would be cost prohibitive. I wish I could though, because this stuff is the bees knees. It’s truly we

avis.titre: Weightless & Eye-Safe — The Perfect Face Sunscreen
avis.texte: ​Living in hot, humid Florida with melasma, I’ve tried MANY sunscreens. This Clear Power Sunscreen is a standout for daily facial wear and high SPF, UVA and UVB protection. ​The Highlights: ​Superior Texture: It’s a clear gel that stays put and won't drip. It absorbs completely with zero greasiness and feels weightless on the skin. ​Makeup Friendly: It spreads easily and sits perfectly under makeup without pilling or feeling heavy. ​No Eye Sting: Unlike most sunscreens, this formula didn't irritate or sting my eyes—a major win for facial application. ​Sensitive-Skin Friendly: It is reef-safe and virtually scent-free. ​Considerations: ​Size & Price: At 50ml (1.7 oz), it’s a bit pricey. I reserve this exclusively for my face and neck to make it more cost-effective. ​Overall: If you need a high-performance, non-greasy sunscreen that survives humidity and won't sting your eyes, this is worth the investment.

This 1.7 oz clear sunscreen is great to slip in your purse or a bag when you’re on the go. It’s small and compact and it seals well to prevent spills. It’s of a clear consistency and goes on smoothly. I was afraid that it would make my skin shiny but it doesn’t. There’s no visible residue left behind when you put it on so that’s a plus. I don’t particularly care for the smell. It doesn’t smell bad but it does have an off scent to it, I don’t know how to explain it. I just don’t like it. The good thing is that the smell seems to go away almost immediately after you put it on. It gives good protection from the sun. I wore it during an outdoor soccer match in the middle of the day and I had no sun burns. So far, I’m happy with this sunscreen. It’s a great choice!

avis.titre: Clean and clear sun protection, easy to apply, long lasting, no white cast, gentle on skin
avis.texte: This sunscreen feels very light and goes on clear. The sunscreen feels like a thin silky silicone layer at first when you apply it, a bit dry greasy, but that sensation disappears quickly and you are left with a protection that feels like it’s not there and you have no visible white cast or shine. I really like the texture that makes it super simple to apply and get more even coverage. It lasts for a good amount of time, even when running or exercising outdoors and sweating a lot. This sunscreen is waterproof and sweat resistant for up to 80 minutes, which is excellent quality, combined with an SPF 50 and dermatologist tested reliability. A wonderful alternative to regular sunscreen! Much better texture and application. No scent. Highly recommended!

This is a really nice sunscreen overall, and I plan to keep using it, though only on my face and neck due to cost. The texture is a lightweight, non-greasy gel that spreads easily and absorbs quickly with no white cast, which is a big plus. It feels comfortable on the skin, even when sweating. There is a mild chemical sunscreen smell, but it’s not strong and fades quickly. The container is slim and very portable, which makes it perfect for a sports bag or for travel. I tested this on a recent trip to San Diego and was impressed with how well it held up during active days outside. I’ll definitely be keeping this in my tennis bag this summer. The only reason I’m giving it 4 stars instead of 5 is the price. It works beautifully, but it’s on the expensive side for the amount you get. If price isn’t a concern, it’s an excellent option, especially for sports or anyone who dislikes heavy, greasy sunscreens.

I know I should be wearing sunscreen every day. I usually avoid it because I dislike white cast and sticky textures. Finding a sunscreen that works well without those issues has always been a challenge for me. I was very excited to try this sunscreen since it was new to me. It comes in a small, travel-friendly container, which makes it easy to toss into a bag. It does have a noticeable chemical scent that’s a bit strong at first. It doesn’t linger or stay on the skin for long. The sunscreen itself is a clear gel that applies smoothly and leaves no white cast at all. It spreads easily, though it does feel slightly tacky for a few minutes after application. Once it dries down, it has a matte finish with very little sheen. It feels lightweight and comfortable on my skin, making it much more pleasant to wear than many sunscreens I’ve tried in the past.

avis.titre: Looks good. Feels good. Works well.
avis.texte: I do a lot of activities outside that often result in me sweating. It may be working in the yard or garden or walking/hiking. Many sunscreens will slip off my face. I need one that will stay in place and provide protection. This is why I was interested in this Clear Power Sunscreen – Invisible, No White Cast, Weightless Gel Sunscreen for Face. Pros: - Well-sealed. No leaks or residue on the container. - Applies well. - No white cast. - Doesn't feel heavy. - Absorbs well without stickiness. - Protection lasts even after sweating. - Reasonable value when compared to others. Cons: - None. Overall, I'm pleased with it. It doesn't feel heavy or sticky. It absorbs well without being visible, no white cast. It stayed in place even once I started sweating. It wasn't drippy, so there isn't as much waste as there has been with others. I had no irritation or breakouts after using it. Considering the quality, less waste, feel, appearance, and the fact that it held up through activities, I think the value is reasonable when compared to others that work well. This is something that I will get again in the future.

avis.titre: The best facial sunscreen I’ve EVER used!!
avis.texte: - There is a lot number, as well as as an expiration date printed on the box and the bottle itself. - I think this is the only facial sunscreen I have used that it a clear gel. The gel itself is thick and applies easily while drying incredibly quickly. It does not leave any tackiness or greasy feeling like some sunscreens do, I mean zero. It actually makes my skin feel very smooth and silky. My makeup applies so well over it. I was (and am still) genuinely shocked at how well this sunscreen dries down. - There is a bit of chemical smell to the sunscreen. There are no added fragrances which is great. The addition of aloe is interesting, I don’t think I’ve seen that in a sunscreen before. - I love that this is spf 50! I prefer to use a higher spf on my face especially. It is worth noting that one of the UV filters in this product is Octocrylene which is a controversial ingredient and can cause irritation for those with sensitive skin. - Price wise, this product is currently $36 for 1.7oz which is a bit expensive. But due to the fact that the sunscreen is a thick gel, it does not take much more than a dime size amount to fully protect my face all day. Not to mention, again, this sunscreen dries down completely. You would have no idea that you’ve applied sunscreen. It almost feels like I’ve applied a makeup primer. - Overall, I have to give this five stars. Yes, it could smell a bit better and it is a little expensive. avis.titre: No skin oiliness and absorbs quickly like a favorite serum
avis.texte: This sunscreen came with a card showing it’s officially used by the USA olympic swim team. That grabbed my attention. The sunscreen had a slight chemical scent, but it was not strong enough to be an issue to me. It absorbed into my skin instantly, had a similar consistency to a serum, and it left my skin feeling soft and smooth, with no stickiness or oiliness present. I applied my makeup within three minutes of applying the sunscreen. I wasn’t able to see any sign of the sunscreen at all after I applied it. It was completely invisible. This is a great product to use when I am rushing to get ready in the morning, and need to reapply sunscreen throughout the day. Though it is on the higher price point, I feel this sunscreen is justified with the high quality and because it’s completely invisible on my skin and absorbs without adding anyskin oiliness.

This Clear Power Sunscreen combines two elements I really like in a sunscreen: a clear gel formula, and SPF 50. The gel formula is absolutely transparent. It feels like a slick gel/jelly and rubs on smoothly with no white cast. It does not leave a shiny or dewy glow, either! Thank goodness. This sunscreen ends up melting into my skin and facial products, and I end up with a very soft, satin complexion. I have used this brand in the past, and have been impressed with their simple, but effective, offerings. One of my favorite lip stains is from this brand, so I have had experience with the efficacy and longevity of other products in the line. The sunscreen is just as good as the lip stain, and I am very pleased to discover that there are more products in this brand's lineup. I am thrilled that this is SPF 50. Lately I have been in love with sunscreens whose highest formulas are lower than 50 (why??? WHY????). I use SPF 50 on a regular basis, since I have a fair complexion and don't really want to risk any sunburn at all. This comfortable, silky sunscreen is gentle against my skin and without any fragrance. It doesn't irritate my skin, and it works well with my cosmetics which I apply over this last step of skincare. To me, this is pretty perfect sunscreen. Highly recommended.

avis.titre: Lightweight, Effective Sunscreen for Everyday Protection
avis.texte: Clear Power Sunscreen is a standout for anyone looking for reliable sun protection without the heavy, greasy feel of traditional sunscreens. Its lightweight, clear formula absorbs quickly and leaves no white cast, making it perfect for all skin tones and easy to layer under makeup or skincare. The texture feels smooth and comfortable, providing broad-spectrum protection while keeping skin hydrated and soft. It stays put throughout the day without feeling sticky or clogging pores, which makes it ideal for both daily wear and active outdoor use. Overall, Clear Power Sunscreen combines effective UV defense, comfort, and a clean, invisible finish, making it a go-to choice for anyone seeking practical and reliable sun protection.

avis.titre: Easy to apply, no greasy feeling, reef safe
avis.texte: Overall I was very pleased with this clear power sunscreen. The sunscreen is a clear gel that goes on easily. No greasy mess after applying, and no irritation noted. The gel absorbed quickly. I was very happy with the protection the sunscreen provided, after working in the garden most of the day, no redness or burning. I also noticed that even while sweating the sunscreen did not sting my eyes. For the price I will definitely keep to using this on my face and neck. No issues applying makeup, and the sunscreen is listed as reef safe. I would definitely purchase again.

This sunscreen is something special. It’s clear obviously, which is great that it doesn’t leave a white film but also, it feels better than any sunscreen I’ve ever tried. It goes on with a very light feeling. Overall very happy with it!
